fact: The Right to Access Information Commission's open data page names the national Open Data Portal for Sierra Leone (www.opendatasl.gov.sl), says the Commission provides overall management and the Ministry of Information and Communications technical guidance, and lists a 2016 Open Data policy among the documents on the page; it states no dataset count or publishing ministry, and the date used is the page's own publication date, 2017-01-18.
system: Open Data Portal for Sierra Leone

fact: Vice President Victor Bockarie Foh formally launched the national open data portal opendata.gov.sl on 2015-05-15, fulfilling a June 2014 OGP commitment; the World Bank assessment says its strategy, governance and management were not yet set.

The World Bank readiness assessment of November 2015 says few datasets had been uploaded to the portal since launch, and names only the NERC Ebola care facilities list as released under an open licence (CC-BY).

The SLEITI open data policy states that SLEITI publishes extractives data in EITI Reports and that mining payment and licence data is published and accessible through the Government of Sierra Leone's Online Repository, drawing on the Mining Cadastre Administration System; the document carries no printed date and is dated 2016.
system: Government of Sierra Leone Online Repository

fact: The OGP National Action Plan III describes the government Open Data Portal as being revamped and as hosted at the Ministry of Information and Communications, managed by the National Open Data Council steered by the Right to Access Information Commission and Statistics Sierra Leone, as a one-stop shop for government documents; as_of is the document's published date.
